text.card: A red giant 5,246 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.67 solar masses and 21.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,594 K at its surface.
